### Color palette used
- Sidebar gradient: `#1a2332` → `#1e2a3a` (dark navy)
- Primary text/accent: `#2c3e50` (dark slate)
- Content background: `#f0f2f5` (light gray)
- Role tag colors: `admin: '#C9A227'` (gold), `lawyer: '#2980b9'` (blue), `secretary: '#27ae60'` (green)
- Various `rgba(0,0,0,...)` and `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)` overlays; Ant Design `theme.useToken()` tokens for `colorBgContainer`, `colorBorderSecondary`, `colorFillSecondary`

- App is RTL/Arabic (`'لوحة التحكم'`, `'تسجيل الخروج'`, etc.)
- Collapse state persisted only in component state (not localStorage)
- Selected menu key derived directly from `location.pathname`
- Logout calls `logout()` then navigates to `/login`
